messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert — org=BlueCanyon experiencing a sudden spike. High 5xx rate + elevated p95 on /v1/generate. Current qps ~4200 (baseline ~800). Paging @maria (oncall).

maria: grabbing it. looking at infra dashboard https://dash.redwood/bluecanyon — seeing huge queueing on inference workers and CPU+OOM spikes on a subset of pods.

kevin: quick read — org token bucket configured qps=800 with burst 100. Requests are backing up, KV cache thrash observed. 502s from overloaded inference workers. probable breathless client retry storms.

ashley: CS here, BlueCanyon reporting widespread 502s from their production traffic. Customer-facing team alerted, sending status note.

maria: proposed mitigations: 1) apply temporary org qps increase (hotfix) to relieve queueing 2) enable per-route shaping to protect core generation paths 3) disable non-essential realtime features (streaming/webhooks) for that org to reduce load. roll for 30m and monitor.

maria: applying override now — executing internal endpoint:

```
POST /internal/orgs/bluecanyon/rl-override
{
  "qps": 1500,
  "ttl_secs": 1800,
  "reason": "emergency spike - temporary hotfix"
}
```

deploy-bot: override applied — id=rl-ovr-8732 status=success actor=maria note="qps=1500 ttl=1800s"

kevin: seeing early signals — error rate dropping already. 5xx rate down from ~12% -> ~3.5% in 90s. p95 latency improving from 2.3s -> 980ms. keep watching.

nicole: tagging product for follow-up. we'll need a postmortem + mitigation plan (client-side backoff guidance, better circuit-breakers). @maria can you add notes to INC-2026-BC when stable?

ashley: CS update sent to BlueCanyon: "We're applying a temporary traffic smoothing rule to stabilize your traffic; streaming may be reduced for ~30 minutes while we monitor." customer acknowledged.

maria: also toggled adaptive shaping on heavy endpoints to drop long poll requests and deprioritize background maps. small perf hit but protects critical generation requests.

kevin: metrics now: error rate 1.2% after 3m, p95 ~730ms. QPS settled ~1450 for the org. Good short-term effect.

raj: runbook note — emergency RL overrides must include TTL + rollback plan. if error rate rises above 2% after override, escalate to infra lead. Also schedule follow-up to examine root cause (traffic pattern change or client bug).

maria: creating incident ticket INC-2026-BC and attaching logs + trace sample. will document the exact commands used and the reason. handoff to kevin in 20m.

kevin: taking over on-call. I've set secondary alerts (error_rate>1.5% and p95>1s) and a dashboard watch. plan: if stable for 25m, start staged rollback to baseline qps=800 via API with 5m canary.

maria: ack. rollback command saved: `POST /internal/orgs/bluecanyon/rl-override { "qps": 800, "ttl_secs": 0 }` — will only run after canary checks pass.

deploy-bot: note — logs/ovr/rl-ovr-8732 archived and attached to INC-2026-BC.

ashley: CS will send a short incident summary to the customer once status is stable.

kevin: will update here at 10m intervals. currently no further escalation. moving to mitigation/monitoring phase.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident acknowledged. Paging closed, on-call handoff to kevin.

maria: thanks team — great quick work. follow-up postmortem to be scheduled.
